title: Binance to Transfer Tokens from Alpha Account to Spot Account - 2025-04-22
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Between  2025-04-22 08:00 (UTC) to 2025-04-22 12:00 (UTC) , Binance will be transferring the following tokens from users’ Binance  Alpha Account  to  Spot Account . BIGTIME VIRTUAL ONDO TUT MUBARAK BROCCOLI  (on Binance Alpha) /  BROCCOLI714  (on Binance Spot)* BANANAS31 PARTI BMT GPS SHELL TST CHEEMS  (on Binance Alpha) /  1000CHEEMS  (on Binance Spot)* COOKIE CGPT AIXBT MONKY** Please note: Users will  not  be able to transfer the tokens back to their Binance Alpha Account once the event starts. Users will then be able to trade, deposit or withdraw the above tokens via networks supported by Binance. *Some tokens may adopt a different name and/or denomination after transferring to Binance Spot Account. **Only the withdrawal function is available for MONKY. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-04-21
